common_gotchas: The DAT can output up to many metadata columns; downstream table lookups should key by header names, not column positions.
Value and Eval columns differ: one is displayed/evaluated value text, the other is a Python object representation.
Wildcard and NOT patterns in Operators and Parameters can match more parameters than expected in large components.
Include Op Name and Rename settings change parameter names, which can break consumers expecting raw Par names.
key_concepts: Outputs a table of parameter names and values from one or more operators.
Operator and parameter patterns select which OPs and parameters are represented.
Output-page toggles choose value, eval, expression, export, mode, style, tuplet, path, and menu-index columns.
Define-page toggles expose parameter metadata such as min/max, clamp, default, enabled, read-only, sections, and menu labels.
